$comment: Choice-length balance for FORM-A. The key was the longest option in 8 of 12 multiple-choice items (66.7% against 25% by chance) — a student could score well by picking the longest option without reading the stem. Keys are trimmed of redundant qualification and terse distractors are made as specific as the rest. No choice changes meaning, so the authored distractor rationales remain accurate.
